ddl: CREATE TABLE scalars (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, note TEXT, n BIGINT, score DOUBLE, active BOOLEAN)
CREATE TABLE typed (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, amount DECIMAL(18,6), day DATE, clock TIME, stamp TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE vectors (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, embedding VECTOR(3, L2), note TEXT)
CREATE TABLE col (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, note TEXT, score DOUBLE) WITH (storage='columnar')
index: CREATE INDEX vec_idx ON vectors(embedding) USING HNSW
knn_query: SELECT id FROM vectors ORDER BY vector_distance(embedding, [0.0,1.0,2.0], 'l2') ASC LIMIT 1
